scope: Corrected baked body+shadow atlases after v7 review: cast direction changed to down-right/east-southeast, connected to foot contact, no 256-cell border alpha.

source_generation.method: built_in_imagegen body sources plus built_in_imagegen corrected shadow source
source_generation.body_sources: Accepted TargetMatchV5 static facings and soldier_animation_v5 frames.
source_generation.postprocess: alpha extraction from corrected imagegen shadow source, split/normalize to 256 cells, deterministic compositing under imagegen body frames, atlas packing, contact sheet, placement proof, metadata and validation

correction_from_v7.v7_problem: down-left shadow direction, detached/too-low contact, alpha clipped at 256-cell bottom edge causing visible box artifacts
correction_from_v7.v8_fix: down-right/east-southeast connected cast, smaller restrained footprint, no alpha on 256-cell border

assessment.player_shadow: V8 now casts down-right from the foot contact, matching the target diagnostic crop direction more closely than v7. The shadow is connected to the boot area and no longer clips the 256-cell border.
assessment.enemy_shadow: V8 enemy cast follows the same down-right target direction under the accepted SE enemy body; no separate runtime shadow transform is needed.
assessment.remaining: Needs PM/user visual approval and Gameplay runtime proof using v8 baked atlases.
